title: JobPacket
description: The paperwork bundle created when a booking lands: a public intake form the customer fills, a work-order doc, a Sign draft of the work authorization (agents can prepare but not send), a CRM deal, and a linked follow-up task. Every field is nullable because each step is non-fatal; a step that fails lands in errors and the booking still completes. Stored on Job.packet and logged via AgentAction.

signDocumentId.description: Sign draft id for the work authorization

signStatus.description: preview_pending means a human must tap confirm-send

dealId.description: CRM deal id linked to the contact
